expected: Every agent-generated temp file lands under the WORKSPACE-ROOT .dadaia/tmp/<agent>/<date>/, never inside repos/<slug>/. A repo's working tree must never contain a .dadaia/ directory at all (workspace-vs-repo boundary law).
notes: Removed the stray repos/dadaia-workspace/.dadaia/ directory (was empty, safe delete) during v0.1.69 code-review remediation (FIX 1/FIX 2 session). Root cause of the tmp-file materializing inside the repo instead of the workspace root not yet investigated — likely a cwd-resolution issue in whatever code-reviewer tooling wrote it while its cwd was inside repos/dadaia-workspace/ rather than the workspace root, or a hand-authored write that bypassed the dadaia-handoff-emitter/tmp-file-guardrail workspace-root-resolution step.
repro: Run a Layer-1 agent (code-reviewer, seen 2026-07-09 03:28) that writes a tmp file; inspect repos/dadaia-workspace/ afterwards for a stray .dadaia/ directory. Then run the full pytest suite (pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q) and observe tests/unit/features/ci_preflight/test_no_pollution.py::test_mypy_cache_dir_redirected_outside_repo fail because resolve_mypy_cache_dir(start=None) resolves to repos/dadaia-workspace/.dadaia/tmp/ci-preflight/mypy-cache.
symptom: Found a stray repos/dadaia-workspace/.dadaia/tmp/code-reviewer/20260709/ directory (empty) inside the repo working tree, alongside a bare repos/dadaia-workspace/.dadaia/ (no states/ sentinel). This is a hard violation per the root AGENTS.md 'Repo cleanliness' law: .dadaia/ is workspace-level ONLY and must never exist inside a repo. It caused a full-suite pytest failure (test_mypy_cache_dir_redirected_outside_repo) because resolve_mypy_cache_dir() walks up from the module file and treats any directory containing .dadaia/ as a workspace root, resolving the mypy cache dir to inside the repo.
title: code-reviewer session materialized .dadaia/tmp/ inside repos/dadaia-workspace/ instead of the workspace root
